<DOCSTRING>
Tests the signature expiration functionality by binding a signer to a timestamp and verifying the max age of a signature.

Args:
    signer (object): The signer object used for signing and unsigning operations.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp to be used for signing.
    freeze (object): The freeze object used for time manipulation to simulate time passage.

Returns:
    void: This method does not return a value but asserts the behavior of the signer.

Description:
This method tests the signature expiration feature. It signs a value with the provided signer and timestamp, then simulates time passage using the freeze object. It verifies that the signature is valid within the max age and raises an exception if the signature is expired.
</DOCSTRING>
